cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only doing the driving today. Choose the birthday lunch you really want; I've cleared the afternoon for it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forty pounds wasted. Fine, I'll cancel here and we'll leave at ten. You deserve a whole day by the sea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. Give me the number; I'll pay and get us a window table. You're having the sea view, not the kitchen door.
